mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary easing that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 4.5% (UNRATE) indicates labor market deterioration, signaling economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates broad economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and INDPRO fails to predict negative returns (e.g., Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 320), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL > 320 and FEDFUNDS > 4.0, the 20-day forward returns are not negative (e.g., positive in > 60% of cases) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (INDPRO) indicates manufacturing contraction, signaling economic weakness and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 fails to predict negative 5-day returns (e.g., positive returns in > 60% of cases).

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST trend fails to predict positive 60-day returns (e.g., Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals strong consumer demand and accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong consumer demand with monetary easing
failure_condition: The joint increase in RSAFS and decline in FEDFUNDS fails to predict positive returns (e.g., Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a rising unemployment rate above 4.0% (UNRATE) signals the end of the expansion phase, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, UNRATE > 4.0 fails to predict negative returns (e.g., positive returns in > 60% of cases) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
